g.text: INITIAL ISSUE. REPLACES REV B SKETCHES
SEE hardware/HARDWARE_BUILD.md SECTION 6 FOR THE ASSEMBLY
MICROPHONE PORTS (LOGO SIDE OF ITEM 6) FACE UP. NOTHING
ITEM 6 RESTS ON ITEM 5 ONLY. NO RIGID PART TOUCHES THE CASE.
STRAP ITEM 8 RUNS ALONG X BETWEEN THE MICROPHONE PAIRS.
EACH END PASSES DOWN THROUGH A SLOT, AROUND THE PLATE EDGE,
AND CLOSES ON ITSELF (DETAIL C). IT DOES NOT PASS UNDER
THE CENTER OF THE PLATE, WHERE ITEMS 1 AND 2 SIT.
ITEM 4 SCREWS ENTER ITEM 2 FROM ABOVE THROUGH MATCH-DRILLED
HOLES IN ITEM 3. SCREW POSITIONS SHOWN ARE NOT VERIFIED.
RELIEVE ITEM 5 OVER THE SCREW HEADS IF THE CASE ROCKS.
FORM A LOOSE LOOP IN CABLE ITEM 9 AND TIE IT AT THE TWO
ITEM 7 IS HELD BY TWO ELASTIC LOOPS, ITEM 11, RUN DIAGONALLY
LEVEL ITEM 3 WITHIN 2 DEGREES. WEIGHT THE BASE OF ITEM 1.
CASE HEIGHT, CASE OUTLINE, AND USB SOCKET POSITION ARE NOT
PRELIMINARY. THIS ASSEMBLY HAS NOT BEEN BUILT.
STRAP, HOOK AND LOOP, 3 TIES JOINED
CABLE W1, USB-C TO USB-A, 2 m
